pages.text: A fair test varies one factor while keeping other relevant conditions equal. Repeated measurements reveal variation. If light and fertilizer both differ between plant groups, their separate effects cannot be isolated. To investigate fertilizer, use comparable plants, keep light and water equal, vary fertilizer, measure growth and repeat the comparison. These observations concern the tested plants and conditions, not every possible plant or environment.
